buildNotes.forgeBuildSizes: exit 1 — StableStaker runtime 25,389 B vs EIP-170 24,576 B (margin -813 B). PRE-EXISTING and expected; NOT a finding. CrossVersionMigrator 4,529 B, InPlaceMigrator 12,163 B both well under.

findings.description: pool.totalStaked/user.amount/user.rewardDebt written after external calls to phUSD.mint (via _settle) and strategy.deposit (via _routeDeposit). Function carries nonReentrant + whenNotPaused; callees are trusted protocol contracts. Retained for dedup only because strategy is owner-swappable.
Same pattern as SLITHER-001 on the migrator-only deposit path (nonReentrant + onlyMigrator).

yieldStrategy[token] cleared and poolState[token] set to Migrating after strategy.relinquishPrincipal/withdraw via _routeExit. nonReentrant + onlyMigrator. Cross-function reentrancy would need a malicious/faulty yield strategy.
yieldStrategy[token] assigned after _routeExit external calls. onlyOwner and (per prior runs) gated on totalStaked==0.
parked/migrationBegin/totalParked cleared after staker.depositFor re-injection in _reinjectWithTopup. onlyOwner + nonReentrant; the external callee is the staker itself.

Return value of strategy.deposit(token, idleBalance, address(this)) is discarded on the idle-sweep leg, unlike _routeDeposit which uses the credited amount. If a strategy credits less than deposited, the shortfall is unrecorded. Only genuine unused-return in the set (the other 11 are EnumerableSet add/remove booleans or tuple destructures).

block.timestamp >= migrationBegin[token][msg.sender] + migrationTimeout gates the parked-funds escape hatch. Retained per Law-1 (time-driven protocol; timestamp findings are NOT dropped in this suite).
Reward accrual keyed on block.timestamp vs pool.lastRewardTime (also pendingReward:658). Load-bearing time logic; retained for the econ/code scanners rather than dropped.
nonReentrant declared after onlyOwner (lines 165 and 203), so the guard is not the first modifier evaluated. Benign here (onlyOwner makes no external call) but an ordering nit worth normalizing.
